INSERT INTO tbl_group_challenge_daily_result (group_id, user_id, challenge_date, daily_amount, target_count) SELECT m.group_id, m.user_id, #{challengeDate}, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(t.refunded_amount, t.amount) ELSE t.amount END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_refund = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM tbl_group_member m JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = m.group_id LEFT JOIN tbl_transaction t ON t.user_id = m.user_id AND t.tr_date = #{challengeDate}
WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} GROUP BY m.group_id, m.user_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_amount = VALUES(daily_amount), target_count = VALUES(target_count)
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS result_id, r.user_id AS user_id, r.challenge_date AS challenge_date, r.effective_amount AS amount, AS nickname FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result r JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = r.group_id JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} AND r.challenge_date = #{challengeDate} AND r.effective_amount > g.limit_amount AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_indictment i WHERE i.result_id = r.id) ORDER BY r.user_id

SELECT t.result_id, t.user_id, t.challenge_date, t.amount, t.nickname FROM ( SELECT r_end.id AS result_id, r_end.user_id AS user_id, r_end.challenge_date AS challenge_date, g.limit_amount AS limit_amount, AS nickname, (SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = r_end.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date) AS amount FROM tbl_challenge_group g JOIN tbl_group_challenge_daily_result r_end ON r_end.group_id = g.id AND r_end.challenge_date = g.end_date JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = r_end.user_id WHERE g.id = #{groupId} ) t WHERE t.amount > t.limit_amount AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_indictment i WHERE i.result_id = t.result_id) ORDER BY t.user_id

SELECT r.id, r.group_id, r.user_id, r.challenge_date, r.daily_amount, r.verdict_deduction_amount, r.effective_amount, r.target_count FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result r JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = r.group_id WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} AND g.eval_type = 'DAILY' AND r.verdict_deduction_amount > 0 AND r.verdict_deduction_amount > r.daily_amount ORDER BY r.user_id, r.challenge_date

SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.social_name) AS nickname, u.profile_image_key AS profile_image_key, CASE WHEN g.eval_type = 'PERIOD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = m.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT rd.effective_amount FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rd WHERE rd.group_id = g.id AND rd.user_id = m.user_id AND rd.challenge_date = #{challengeDate}), 0) END AS amount FROM tbl_group_member m JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY m.user_id

SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, t.tr_date AS tr_date, t.tr_time AS tr_time, t.merchant_name AS merchant_name, CASE WHEN t.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(t.refunded_amount, t.amount) ELSE t.amount END AS amount, cat.category_name AS category_name, t.is_refund AS is_refund, t.source_type AS source_type, t.direction AS direction, card.institution_name AS card_institution_name, acc.bank_name AS account_bank_name FROM tbl_transaction t JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} LEFT JOIN tbl_category cat ON cat.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_card card ON card.id = t.card_id LEFT JOIN tbl_connected_account acc ON acc.id = t.account_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.tr_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
ORDER BY t.tr_date, t.tr_time, t.id

SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, m.lives_count AS lives_count, CASE WHEN g.eval_type = 'PERIOD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = m.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rd.effective_amount) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rd WHERE rd.group_id = g.id AND rd.user_id = m.user_id AND rd.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) END AS charge_amount FROM tbl_group_member m JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = m.group_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY m.user_id

SELECT RANK() OVER (
ORDER BY base.lives_count DESC, base.total_consumption ASC
ORDER BY base.total_consumption ASC
) AS `rank`, base.user_id AS user_id, base.nickname AS nickname, base.profile_image_key AS profile_image_key, base.lives_count AS lives_count, base.total_consumption AS total_consumption FROM ( SELECT m.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.social_name) AS nickname, u.profile_image_key, m.lives_count, CASE WHEN g.eval_type = 'PERIOD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = m.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rd.effective_amount) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rd WHERE rd.group_id = g.id AND rd.user_id = m.user_id AND rd.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) END AS total_consumption FROM tbl_group_member m JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ) base ORDER BY `rank`, base.user_id

SELECT m.final_rank AS `rank`, m.user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.social_name) AS nickname, u.profile_image_key AS profile_image_key, m.lives_count AS lives_count, m.final_outcome AS final_outcome, m.final_charge_amount AS final_charge_amount, CASE WHEN g.eval_type = 'PERIOD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = m.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rd.effective_amount) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rd WHERE rd.group_id = g.id AND rd.user_id = m.user_id AND rd.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) END AS total_consumption FROM tbl_group_member m JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY m.final_rank, m.user_id
